title: config/checklist.json
description: The Git hooks that a checkout installs and the pattern of the item IDs of the checklists. The checklists are docs/plans/<plan>/checklist.md, which kit finds itself (K241); each is a table with the six states of kit.

hooks.description: The tracked hooks of .githooks that every checkout installs; pre-push is required and runs the push gate.

idPattern.description: The source of the regular expression that an item ID matches as a whole, such as K[0-9]+(?:[.-][0-9]+)*; an ID that ends in -<number> is a sub-item of the ID without it.
